name: Sanskrit Wikisource - Samaveda Kauthuma Samhita, 'sasvara purna' (fully accented arcika)
recension_evidence: The page title path names कौथुमीया (Kauthuma), and the body's own section headers run पूर्वार्चिकः/च्षन्द 1.1.1 through नवमप्रपाठकः -- the Kauthuma two-arcika arrangement with nine Uttararcika prapathakas. Not Ranayaniya (Benfey's six books) and not Jaiminiya. Independently: 1,136 of its verses are text-identical to our Kauthuma arcika under a declared normalisation, in canonical order.
